basic_details.job_title: KGMU Study Coordinator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

how_to_apply: Submit the application with resume on plain paper by 4:00 PM on 19 November 2026, with the subject line "Application for Study Coordinator.".
Shortlisted candidates are notified by email regarding the interview.
At the interview, bring the documents listed in the notice and submit them to the office of Dr. Nishant Verma, Department of Pediatrics, KGMU, Lucknow.
